{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out refunded orders (only completed orders count)
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rates = completed_orders.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean() * 100

# Print the conversion rates for each segment
print("Conversion rates by customer_segment:")
for segment, rate in conversion_rates.items():
    print(f"  {segment}: {rate:.2f}%")

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rates.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rates.max()

print(f"\nHighest conversion rate: {best_segment} with {best_rate:.2f}%")

# Return the best segment
best_segment"}
